# City Defender

## How to Play
- Pilot your ship with **WASD/Arrows** (rotate: A/D, thrust: W/S)
- Destroy enemy waves before they breach the city perimeter
- Collect **Salvage** to repair city segments and unlock upgrades
- Use **Shift** to boost (2× thrust, trail particles)
- Survive until the city reaches its destination checkpoint!
